---
title: "Stage 5.1 — Spatial-process figure"
output: html_document
params:
  config_file: "config/madagascar.yml"
  process_figure_species: "Cryptoprocta ferox" # null skips this stage
  clump_backend: "auto"
  grass_dir: null
---

```{r run, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
source(file.path("R", "stage51_workflow.R"))
rmd_options <- project_rmd_params("5.1_single_species_aoh_patches_pu_process.Rmd")
configured <- rmd_project_config(rmd_options, "stage51")
rmd_params <- configured$params
context <- application_rmd_context(rmd_params)
validate_application_rmd_spatial_inputs(context, rmd_params)
config <- stage51_application_config(rmd_params, context)
describe_stage5_config(config, "Stage 5.1")
stage51_result <- run_stage51(config)
application_commit_boundary(
  context, application_stage51_boundary(config, stage51_result)
)
```

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
print(as.data.frame(stage51_result[setdiff(names(stage51_result), "figure")]))
if (length(stage51_result$figure) && file.exists(stage51_result$figure)) {
  print(knitr::include_graphics(stage51_result$figure))
}
```
